verdict.rationale: The only first-party natural-language capability in the pack is Azure Copilot, which can generate Terraform configurations (azure-docs-19). That is a narrow, single-mention case of natural-language operation. The CLI, tab-completion, JMESPath queries and declarative IaC are not natural-language interfaces. The official MCP server is a building block for external agents and belongs to a separate story, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented natural-language operation of resources beyond Terraform generation (e.g., Copilot executing actions or querying resources), the scope of Copilot's natural-language commands, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
